patches.name: Supersaw Chord Stab
patches.description: 7-voice detuned stereo supersaw with tight punch envelope — establishes harmonic gravity on beats 1 & 2.5 before the bass hocket answers.

patches.name: FM Monster Growl
patches.description: 3-operator harmonic FM (1:2:4) into asymmetric wavefolder and dual-bandpass vowel filter. Sweeping vowel O -> A makes the bass 'roar'.

patches.name: Talking 'Yoi' Bass
patches.description: Steep resonant formant sweep from dark 'O' (F2=800 Hz) to bright 'I' (F2=2300 Hz) with metallic ring — creates the classic vocal 'YOI' syllable.

patches.name: Sync Wobble Bass
patches.description: Phase-locked clean sub-bass (<110 Hz) paired with a tempo-synced Cytomic SVF lowpass LFO (1/4, 1/8, 1/8T, 1/16) on the gritty mid-bass.

patches.name: 808 Sub Anchor / Drop
patches.description: Chest-hitting C1-B2 fundamental sine/triangle sub with punchy pitch transient. Locks to kick drum steps to anchor the low end.

patches.name: Pitch-Whip Laser Lead
patches.description: High-register octave-whipping saw/FM screech (+12/+24 semitone exponential pitch dive) that slices through the top of the hocket phrase.

patches.name: Glitch Formant Vocal Chop
patches.description: Glottal pulse-train with 1.22x upward-shifted vocal formants and tempo-synced 1/16 or 1/32 stutter gate — the rhythmic answer at bar turnarounds.

gesture_badges.label: Yoi Talk (O -> I)
gesture_badges.why_it_works: Sweeps the 2nd vocal formant from 800 Hz ('O') to 2300 Hz ('I'), mimicking a human mouth opening into a metallic shout.

gesture_badges.label: Monster Growl (O -> A)
gesture_badges.why_it_works: Drives 3-operator harmonic FM and asymmetric wavefolding while opening the throat formant from 'O' to 'A'.

gesture_badges.label: 1/16 Sync Wobble
gesture_badges.why_it_works: Locks filter cutoff oscillation to 16th-note subdivisions while keeping the <110 Hz sub-bass completely rock-solid.

gesture_badges.label: +12st Laser Whip
gesture_badges.why_it_works: Starts one full octave above the target note and whips down exponentially in the first 35% of the note for instant electro impact.

gesture_badges.label: 32nd Glitch Chop
gesture_badges.why_it_works: Slices the vocal formant into rapid-fire micro-gates at bar boundaries to propel the listener into the next downbeat.
